text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience across JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

For this WordPress challenge, I’d approach it as a template orchestration problem: identifying the cleanest way to swap the HTML template at scale across the existing URL set without repeatedly editing the custom template. I’m comfortable thinking through implementation options and recommending the most maintainable path forward.

Recently, I built an end-to-end test suite for Kestrel Insurance using Playwright, GitHub Actions, Docker, and TypeScript. It covered the broker quoting flow with 160 tests running on every pull request, and helped reduce release regressions from 6 a quarter to 1.

If you’d like, I can help you map out the best approach for this first task and turn it into a scalable solution.
